method: One raw step in one field of the selected P0 timing row per trial. The native BIOS timing planner and Apply/Restore transaction ran against the selected GPU. A bounded stock CUDA copy on the 1050 Ti supplied P0 during sampling and exited before each selected-device restart. Each A1/B/A2 records all six controller words bracketed by P-state and memory-clock telemetry.
scope: Controller programming and restoration on this board at this operating point. The sweep did not measure long-duration stability or benchmark performance.
prior_clock_receipt: An interrupted clock receipt was retired with Verify after fresh independent proof of the complete original running image and empty managed registry. No prior clock edits were replayed.
